يختلسوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَلِسُوا (yaḵtalisū) /jax.ta.li.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# يُخْتَلَسُوا (yuḵtalasū) /jux.ta.la.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
